Standalone direct-payoff enumeration and exact Walsh Hodge computation verify N=2,...,9, exact small-N PSD for N=2,...,6 and the published N=7 witness; these finite checks are not used as infinite proofs. No hidden normalization shifts or numerical extrapolations are used.
